signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Zone Hawk defenders lock down a part of the field. When they enter the zone, this ability increases the rate of interceptions while in zone coverage.
Defenders with this ability force more catch knockouts and react quicker in any mid-field zone coverage, less than 20 yards from the LoS inside the numbers and 10-20 outside.
Defenders with this ability are highly likely to force catch knockouts against running backs.
Defenders with this ability can make jumping, 180-degree interceptions while lurking in a zone in the middle of the field.
Effective D-Line captains aren't just examples to follow, they are motivators. When they enter the zone, all opposing blockers have their resistance bars wiped out.
Defenders with this ability use faster run shed moves for a better chance at shedding blocks against inside run plays.
Defenders with this ability will receive dominant bull rush wins when their pass rush points are full
Effective D-Line captains aren't just examples to follow, they are motivators. When they enter the zone, all opposing blockers have their resistance bars wiped out.
Defenders with this ability will ignore one bar of blocker resistance when attempting swim/club pass rush moves
Defenders with this ability will ignore one bar of blocker resistance when attempting speed pass rush moves
Defenders with this ability will frequently prevent additional yardage gains while tackling
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 10-20 yards from the LoS, outside the numbers
Ballcarriers with this ability will break almost any hit-stick tackle attempts made on them.
Ballcarriers with this ability have more powerful truck animations.
Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable juke animations.
Ballcarriers with this ability will frequently attempt to gain extra yards while being tackled
Players with this ability will recover from the effects of fatigue at an increased rate between plays.
Defenders with this ability are granted a free pass rush move once per play after spending a pass rush point
Defenders with this ability will dominantly win run blocks when they correctly use the Guess Play adjustment to predict a run. Incorrect guesses will result in a loss.
Defenders with this ability can reach out of engaged blocks to tackle or sack nearby ballcarriers.
